name: Video Wallpaper
author: p3lusa
description: Desktop wallpaper renderer. Plays the active theme's looping video when it ships a videos/ directory, and otherwise behaves like the stock image background. Videos pause while locked or idle, and the active clip survives shell restarts. Pairs with the companion video-wallpaper theme (p3lusa/video-wallpaper) which ships the clip library and neon skin — the theme alone only shows static images.
